papers.title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
papers.abstract: Abstract An end-to-end flow-matching framework generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories via a cross-asset flow Transformer and a two-stage imitation and group-relative reinforcement learning procedure, improving risk-adjusted returns on cryptocurrency perpetual futures.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Real-world portfolio management requires converting noisy market observations into coordinated, simultaneous allocations across multiple assets under shared capital constraints. Advances in forecasting models and alpha discovery help identify opportunities. However, traditional pipelines often decouple signal forecasting from portfolio construction, potentially misaligning learning with allocation and execution objectives. We present AllocFlow, an end-to-end flow-matching framework that directly generates joint portfolio allocations from raw multi-asset market histories. To capture dependencies among portfolio positions, AllocFlow employs a cross-asset flow Transformer conditioned on temporal market representations to generate continuous, signed position weights across all instruments jointly. To address the sample inefficiency and instability of learning continuous allocation policies from scratch, we establish a two-stage training scheme: strategy-supervised imitation shapes a structured distribution of candidate portfolios, followed by group-relative reinforcement learning (RL) that refines joint decisions using portfolio-level financial rewards and a frozen policy reference. On hourly cryptocurrency perpetual futures, RL refinement raises the annualized net return of the imitation policy from 27.79% to 51.38% and its Calmar ratio from 0.955 to 4.043, surpassing the teacher strategy on every metric, and AllocFlow reaches a Calmar ratio of 4.90 on six further months of unseen 2026 data without retraining.

ru.title: Портфель целиком: от сырого рынка сразу к оптимальным весам
ru.desc: В статье предлагается AllocFlow — end-to-end фреймворк на основе flow-matching, который напрямую генерирует совместные веса портфеля по всем активам из сырой истории рынка. Для учёта зависимостей между позициями используется cross-asset flow Transformer, выдающий непрерывные веса с учётом знака. Обучение проходит в два этапа: сначала supervised imitation учит распределение кандидатных портфелей по стратегии-учителю, затем group-relative reinforcement learning дорабатывает решения по портфельным финансовым наградам с замороженной reference-политикой. На часовых данных криптовалютных perpetual futures RL-доработка поднимает годовую доходность с 27.79% до 51.38% и Calmar ratio с 0.955 до 4.043, а на неизвестных данных 2026 года модель сохраняет Calmar 4.90 без переобучения.

en.title: Generate portfolios together, then refine them with rewards
en.desc: AllocFlow uses raw market histories to generate portfolio weights for multiple assets jointly, rather than forecasting each asset separately and then building a portfolio. A cross-asset flow Transformer models relationships among assets and produces continuous, signed allocations. Training first uses imitation learning to copy a strategy, then group-relative reinforcement learning to improve portfolios based on financial rewards while keeping a frozen policy as a reference. In tests on cryptocurrency perpetual futures, this approach improved risk-adjusted returns and performed well on unseen data without retraining.

zh.title: 从市场历史到联合配置：用流匹配端到端优化投资组合
zh.desc: AllocFlow 是一种端到端框架，直接根据多个资产的历史市场数据生成联合投资组合配置。它使用跨资产 Flow Transformer，同时生成各资产连续且可正可负的仓位权重，以建模资产之间的依赖关系。训练分为两阶段：先通过策略监督模仿学习得到结构化的投资组合，再用基于组相对优势的强化学习，根据组合层面的金融回报进一步优化决策。该方法在加密货币永续合约数据上提升了风险调整后收益，并在未重新训练的后续数据上取得了较高的 Calmar 比率。

papers.title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
papers.abstract: Abstract  We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. Task completion is checked against execution results, changes in environment state, or submitted artifacts. We evaluate Sage S1.5 Flash on 33 benchmarks across seven domains. In the primary comparison against five baselines, it ranks first on OfficeQA Pro (72.2), MLE-bench Lite (90.3 HumanRank), Harvey LAB, and SpreadsheetBench~2, and second on OSWorld-Verified (85.2), WebArena-Verified (67.6), and DeepResearch Bench~II (54.2). These results show particular strengths in using documentary evidence, producing verifiable workbooks, and carrying out machine learning tasks, alongside competitive performance in desktop and browser workflows that require the model to act on visual feedback.

Institute of Software Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Научный ИИ-агент, который рассуждает по данным и действует в среде
ru.desc: Статья представляет Sage S1.5 Flash — mixture-of-experts модель с 320 миллиардами параметров, созданную для рассуждений над научными данными и действий в интерактивных средах. Модель использует отдельные энкодеры для молекулярных графов, биологических последовательностей и спектров, а затем проецирует их в общее пространство входов LLM вместе с текстом и изображениями. Агентные способности обучались в верифицируемых средах для работы с инструментами, поиском и кодом, а результат проверялся по выполнению, изменению состояния или артефактам. На 33 бенчмарках в семи доменах модель занимает первое место в ряде задач, включая OfficeQA Pro и MLE-bench Lite, и показывает конкурентоспособные результаты в десктопных и браузерных сценариях.

en.title: A multimodal expert model that turns scientific evidence into verifiable action
en.desc: Sage S1.5 Flash is a 320-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model built for scientific reasoning and interactive tasks. It uses specialized encoders for molecular graphs, biological sequences, and spectra, then maps their representations into a shared backbone that also processes text and images. The model is trained and tested in verifiable environments for tool use, search, coding, and scientific workflows, where success is checked through execution results, environment changes, or submitted artifacts. Across 33 benchmarks, it performs especially well on evidence-based tasks, spreadsheets, and machine learning experiments, while also showing competitive results in browser and desktop environments.

zh.title: 让科学推理落地为可验证的行动
zh.desc: 本文介绍了 Sage S1.5 Flash，这是一个拥有 3200 亿参数的通用混合专家模型，擅长利用科学证据进行推理并在交互环境中执行任务。它为分子图、生物序列和光谱数据设计了专用编码器，再通过模态投影器将这些表示与文本、图像一起输入共享模型骨干。研究团队还构建了可验证的工具使用、搜索、编程和科学工作流程环境，并根据执行结果、环境变化或提交的成果判断任务是否完成。在 33 项基准测试中，该模型在文档证据处理、生成可验证电子表格和机器学习任务上表现突出，同时也能胜任需要根据视觉反馈操作桌面或浏览器的任务。

papers.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present K2-Horizon, a fleet of six fully open language models, from a 0.9B dense model to a 375B-A23B MoE, built for general-purpose reasoning and agentic work across math and science, software engineering, deep research, office automation, and beyond. The models lead or are competitive with strong open models of their size on agentic and coding benchmarks. On the modeling side, to strengthen reasoning, we introduce Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoVA), applying MoE to attention value projections, and softplus attention gating, a more flexible, theoretically motivated gate. Our 36B-A4B model uses both and nearly matches a 32B dense model trained on the same data, with one-seventh the active parameters. We also introduce Uno, lossless diffusion adapters that speed up decoding by up to 2.2x without a separate draft model. Our release follows the LLM360 definition of open source for transparency and reproducibility: the full development history, including intermediate checkpoints from every training stage, pre-training data, training logs, and all training, evaluation, and infrastructure code, notably our production-scale xLLM framework for dense and MoE training and the RL360 reinforcement-learning stack. Beyond the data itself, we release and document in detail every pipeline that built it, the part of model development that open releases most rarely disclose. These pipelines produced roughly 10T synthetic pre-training tokens, showing that synthetic data can be a major ingredient of pre-training at scale. Four of the models share one 22T-token pre-training corpus and recipe, revealing consistent scaling behavior and enabling controlled studies of scale and sparsity. All artifacts are available at https://ifm.ai/k2/

ru.title: Открытые LLM нового поколения: прозрачность, рассуждения и синтетические данные в масштабе
ru.desc: Авторы представляют K2-Horizon — семейство из шести полностью открытых LLM, от плотной модели на 0.9B до MoE на 375B (23B активных параметров), ориентированных на рассуждения и агентные задачи. Ключевые архитектурные нововведения: Mixture-of-Value Attention (MoE, применённый к value-проекциям внимания) и softplus-гейтинг внимания, а также Uno — lossless diffusion-адаптеры, ускоряющие декодирование до 2.2x без отдельной draft-модели. Модели следуют определению открытости LLM360: публикуются чекпоинты, претрейн-данные, логи обучения и весь код, включая фреймворк xLLM и стек RL360. Показано, что синтетические данные (около 10T токенов) могут быть основным компонентом претрейна в больших масштабах.

en.title: Open models, efficient reasoning, and fully transparent training
en.desc: K2-Horizon is a family of six open language models designed for reasoning and agentic tasks, including coding, science, and office automation. Its Mixture-of-Value Attention and softplus attention gating improve reasoning, while its 36B-A4B model approaches a comparable 32B dense model’s performance using about one-seventh as many active parameters. The paper also introduces Uno, a lossless diffusion adapter that speeds up decoding by up to 2.2 times without needing a separate draft model. To support transparency and reproducibility, the release includes training data, checkpoints, logs, code, and data-generation pipelines, enabling studies of scaling and synthetic data.

zh.title: 更高效的推理，更彻底的开放
zh.desc: K2-Horizon 是一组从 0.9B 到 375B-A23B 的六款开放语言模型，面向推理、编程和智能体任务，在多项基准上表现出竞争力。为增强推理能力，研究提出混合价值注意力（MoVA），在注意力的 value 投影中使用混合专家（MoE），并引入更灵活的 softplus 注意力门控；其中一款稀疏模型仅启用七分之一的参数，性能接近同数据训练的稠密模型。研究还提出 Uno 无损扩散适配器，无需额外草稿模型即可将解码速度提高最多 2.2 倍。项目公开了模型训练各阶段的检查点、数据、日志、代码和数据构建流程，并展示了合成数据可大规模用于预训练。

papers.title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
papers.abstract: Abstract InclusionMed is an open medical AI evaluation initiative that audits and reproduces benchmarks across healthcare roles and capabilities, revealing that model rankings and inference costs vary by context and motivating broader, context-specific evaluation.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.

ru.title: Оценивать медицинский AI нужно в контексте: один рейтинг не отражает все потребности здравоохранения
ru.desc: Статья представляет InclusionMed — открытую инициативу по оценке медицинских AI-моделей, которая аудирует и воспроизводит бенчмарки для разных медицинских ролей и возможностей. Авторы отобрали пять бенчмарков из 388 кандидатов и построили InclusionMed Index, по которому frontier LLM набирают от 17.5 до 49.1 балла из 100. Результаты показывают, что ранг модели меняется в зависимости от роли и типа задачи: например, все топ-10 моделей лучше справляются с коммуникацией с пациентом, чем с клиническим принятием решений. Также модели с близкими баллами заметно различаются по стоимости inference, что подчёркивает необходимость контекстной оценки и выбора модели под конкретную задачу.

en.title: Evaluate Medical AI for Every Care Context
en.desc: The paper introduces InclusionMed, an open initiative for evaluating medical AI across healthcare roles and capabilities. Its Atlas organizes benchmarks, and its first release includes four audited public benchmarks plus a private diagnostic reasoning benchmark. Tests of large language models found that rankings change depending on the role or capability being evaluated, and that top-ranked models performed better on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar overall scores also had different estimated inference costs, underscoring the need for broader, context-specific evaluation and model selection.

zh.title: 让医疗AI评测贴合不同角色与真实需求
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 InclusionMed，这是一个面向包容性医疗的开放式人工智能评估计划。它整理并审查不同医疗角色与人工智能能力的基准，并通过独立复现检验评测结果。研究发现，大语言模型的排名会随医疗角色和任务能力而变化，而且患者沟通得分通常高于临床决策得分。不同模型的推理成本也可能差异很大，因此选择医疗人工智能时应结合具体应用场景，并扩大评测覆盖范围。

papers.title: SPILLWAY: Separating Target Admission from Sanitization to Defend Tool-Using Agents against Prompt Injection
papers.abstract: Abstract  Tool-using agents act on email, files, and payments, so an instruction hidden in a web page or a shared document can make an agent send data or money to an attacker. Many runtime defenses put a language model on the decision that lets an action through, so the decision depends on a model that may read the attacker's text and adds model calls to every step. Provenance defenses keep the model off the final check but need a model to plan or route each task first. Where an action goes can instead be read from the tools' typed returns: an email's sender or a payment's account arrives in a typed field, while injected instructions arrive as free text. SPILLWAY turns this observation into a deterministic floor with no per-task plan. The check admits a call when each target value that appears in tool output but not in the user's task was returned by a read-only tool in a typed field or is covered by a fixed delegation rule. A deterministic sanitizer removes instruction-like regions its fixed rules match before the model reads them and retains the removed spans as evidence, and a local judge may restore a refused call, never one whose target lies in the removed text. Across three backbones, and seven task suites on one of them, no standard templated injection redirects an action to an attacker's target under SPILLWAY, at the highest observed mean utility and composite scores (NRP, ERS) of the defenses we run under that attack. A forged chat template also produces a raw zero, and mean in-scope attack success under a released reinforcement-learning attacker is .007. SPILLWAY reaches this floor with no defense-triggered backbone re-run and almost no added model call. As personal AI agents act on users' email, files, and payments, SPILLWAY gives them an auditable refusal floor on where their actions go that keeps them useful and holds across backbones.

ru.title: Агент не отправит деньги туда, куда велел злоумышленник, потому что адрес получателя проверяется детерминированно
ru.desc: Статья описывает SPILLWAY — детерминированную защиту для LLM-агентов от prompt injection, при которой злоумышленник прячет инструкции в веб-страницах или документах. Система проверяет адреса получателей действий по типизированным полям инструментов, а не по решению языковой модели, что не требует планирования задач заранее. Перед чтением моделью детерминированный санитайзер удаляет инструкциоподобные фрагменты и сохраняет их как доказательства, а локальный судья может восстановить отклонённый вызов. Эксперименты показывают почти нулевой успех атак при сохранении полезности агента и минимальных дополнительных вызовах модели.

en.title: Trust Typed Data, Not Hidden Instructions
en.desc: SPILLWAY protects tool-using agents by checking where an action will send data or money. Its deterministic rule allows targets found in typed fields returned by read-only tools, or targets covered by fixed delegation rules, and blocks targets introduced only through untrusted text. A rule-based sanitizer removes instruction-like text before the model sees it, while a local judge may restore a blocked action only when its target is not in the removed text. Across tested models and attacks, SPILLWAY prevented standard injected instructions from redirecting actions while maintaining high utility, with almost no extra model calls.

zh.title: 用可审计的目标检查，守住代理行动的安全底线
zh.desc: SPILLWAY 是一种保护工具调用代理的防御方法，重点检查邮件收件人或付款账户等操作目标。它利用工具返回的类型化字段，确定用户任务中未提及的目标是否来自只读工具，或是否符合固定的授权规则。系统还会用确定性规则移除可疑指令片段，并保留这些片段作为审计证据；本地判别器可以恢复被拒绝的调用，但不能允许目标来自已移除的文本。实验显示，SPILLWAY 能阻止多种攻击将操作导向攻击者指定的目标，同时保持较高效用，且无需因防御而重新运行主模型。

papers.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
papers.abstract: Abstract  Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.

ru.title: Масштаб языковой модели открывает новые горизонты для роботов
ru.desc: В статье представлена ScaleVLA — модель типа Vision-Language-Action, которая соединяет крупную языковую модель DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash на 552 млрд параметров с обучаемым диффузионным трансформером (DiT) для генерации действий робота. Авторы систематически сравнивают VLM-бэкбоны от 2 до 552 млрд параметров при одинаковом режиме обучения. Оценивались эффективность по числу демонстраций, обобщающая способность на бенчмарке LIBERO-PRO и точность манипуляций в реальном мире, например вставка зарядки. Результаты показывают, что фронтирные VLM служат мощной представляющей основой для робототехнических политик, при этом задержка составляет 216 мс на чанк действий.

en.title: Scale Up Vision-Language Models to Build More Capable Robot Policies
en.desc: The paper introduces ScaleVLA, a robot policy that connects a 552B-parameter vision-language model to a trainable diffusion transformer (DiT) for generating actions. It compares models ranging from 2B to 552B parameters using the same training setup. The largest model learns more efficiently, generalizes better, and succeeds more often at precise tasks such as inserting a charger. These results suggest that large pretrained models can provide strong representations for robot learning while still producing actions with practical speed.

zh.title: 让前沿视觉语言模型成为机器人的强大行动基础
zh.desc: 本文提出 ScaleVLA，将 5520 亿参数的视觉语言模型连接到可训练的动作扩散 Transformer（DiT），用于机器人控制。研究在统一训练设置下比较了 20 亿至 5520 亿参数的视觉语言模型，发现更大的模型能提升样本效率：仅用 10 次示范，成功率就达到 87.8%，超过较小模型用 50 次示范取得的 85.6%。在泛化和精细操作任务中，ScaleVLA 也表现更好：LIBERO-PRO 成功率达到 45.1%，现实中的充电器插入成功次数从 10 次中 4 次提高到 9 次。尽管模型规模庞大，它每个动作片段的中位延迟仍为 216 毫秒，说明前沿视觉语言模型可以成为高效且泛化能力强的机器人策略基础。

papers.title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
papers.abstract: Abstract A benchmark of realistic software engineering assignments reveals that current coding agents struggle to track requirements from clarification through implementation, verification, and handoff, completing few tasks despite partial test success.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash A coding agent working within a software organization must establish what to build, collaborate with colleagues, and verify what it delivers. We introduce SWE-CoWork, a benchmark comprising 101 development assignments across 101 real repositories, 11 programming languages, and 12 application domains. Each assignment places an agent in a simulated engineering organization with 26 colleagues who have distinct responsibilities, bounded knowledge, and controlled collaboration behavior. Starting from a brief handoff, agents must recover requirements distributed across colleagues and workplace records, reconcile conflicting evidence, and implement changes evaluated by private executable tests. We evaluate eleven models and find a substantial gap between partial implementation and complete task delivery. The two leading models satisfy approximately 63% of fail-to-pass (F2P) tests but complete fewer than 8% of assignments. Providing complete requirements upfront improves F2P by approximately 16 percentage points for Seed Evolving and GPT-6 Astra, yet leaves complete task success unchanged. Requirement-level trajectory analysis reveals failures throughout the delivery process: Claude-Opus-5.5 directs a mean of 93% of first questions about queried cards to their accountable owners across runs but obtains only 64% of colleague-held requirements. Deferred questions go unfollowed, implementations remain incomplete even after requirements are acquired, and 31% of requirements reported as completed fail their tests. These findings highlight sustained requirement tracking, from clarification through implementation, verification, and handoff, as a key challenge for reliable autonomous software engineering.

ru.title: Агенты пишут код, но теряют требования по пути к результату
ru.desc: Статья представляет SWE-CoWork — бенчмарк из 101 реалистичного задания по разработке ПО на реальных репозиториях, где LLM-агенты работают в симулированной инженерной организации с 26 коллегами. Агенту нужно собрать распределённые требования, согласовать противоречивые данные и реализовать изменения, которые проверяются приватными тестами. Оценка одиннадцати моделей показала, что при высоком проценте прохождения fail-to-pass тестов (около 63%) полностью выполняется менее 8% задач. Анализ траекторий выявил главную проблему: агенты теряют отслеживание требований на всех этапах — от уточнения до верификации и передачи работы.

en.title: From Requirements to Reliable Delivery
en.desc: SWE-CoWork is a benchmark for testing coding agents on realistic software tasks across repositories, languages, and application areas. Agents must gather and reconcile requirements from simulated colleagues and workplace records, implement changes, and verify them with private executable tests. Although leading models pass about 63% of tests for features they begin implementing, they complete fewer than 8% of assignments, and giving them all requirements upfront does not improve full-task success. The results show that reliable software agents need to track requirements continuously through clarification, implementation, testing, and handoff.

zh.title: 从理解需求到验证交付：让编程智能体真正完成任务
zh.desc: 本文提出 SWE-CoWork 基准，用来评估编程智能体在真实软件工程任务中的协作与交付能力。基准包含 101 个来自真实代码仓库的任务，智能体需要向同事和工作记录获取需求、处理信息冲突，并通过私有可执行测试验证实现。实验发现，模型虽然能通过一部分新增功能测试，但完整完成任务的比例不到 8%；即使提前提供全部需求，完整成功率也没有提升。失败贯穿需求澄清、实现、测试和交接过程，说明智能体需要持续追踪需求并可靠验证交付结果。

papers.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
papers.abstract: Abstract An AI reviewer trained by reinforcement learning to jointly maximize precision and recall of soundness review points outperforms frontier models and other training methods and transfers to other review domains.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Using this dataset, we train an AI reviewer model, PaperCritic, through reinforcement learning with the F1 score of precision and recall as the reward. Our experiments show that PaperCritic outperforms frontier models and models trained with other AI reviewer training methods on an in-domain test set. Surprisingly, learning to review ICLR submissions also transfers to reviewing Nature-family papers and even to out-of-domain reviewing tasks (e.g., code review, legal contract review, and feedback on story writing).

ru.title: Обучаем AI-ревьюера находить главное: точность и полнота в оценке обоснованности
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают AI-ревьюера PaperCritic, который оценивает только обоснованность (soundness) научных статей, так как этот критерий наиболее объективен, в отличие от субъективных interestingness и clarity. Модель обучается с помощью reinforcement learning, где награда — F1-мера, объединяющая precision (содержательность и корректность замечаний) и recall (полнота покрытия эталонных замечаний). Для обучения создан размеченный датасет PaperSound-23K из 1K статей ICLR и 23K замечаний, написанных людьми и LLM. PaperCritic превосходит frontier-модели и альтернативные методы обучения, а также неожиданно переносится на рецензирование статей Nature и даже на задачи вне домена, например ревью кода и юридических договоров.

en.title: Train reviewers to be both precise and thorough
en.desc: The paper trains PaperCritic to assess the soundness of research papers, focusing on whether review points are correct and useful. It introduces PaperSound-23K, a dataset of labeled human- and AI-generated review points. The model uses reinforcement learning, with an F1-based reward that balances precision and recall. PaperCritic outperforms competing models on ICLR reviews and transfers to other research and review tasks.

zh.title: 以强化学习兼顾审稿意见的准确性与覆盖度
zh.desc: 本文聚焦于评估论文论证是否可靠，而非判断其趣味性或表达清晰度等主观特征。研究者构建了 PaperSound-23K 数据集，并训练 AI 审稿模型 PaperCritic，使其同时提升审稿意见的精确率和召回率。训练采用强化学习，以精确率和召回率的 F1 分数作为奖励。实验显示，PaperCritic 优于前沿模型及其他训练方法，并能迁移到期刊论文审阅、代码审查、合同审查和故事反馈等任务。

papers.title: VoxMel TTS Technical Report
papers.abstract: Abstract VoxMel is a tokenizer-free autoregressive TTS framework that uses an invertible two-axis Haar transform to decompose mel spectrograms into Coarse-Mel and residual tiers, enabling stable high-fidelity generation with strong recognition and speaker-similarity results.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Continuous autoregressive TTS relies on an acoustic target that enables stable next-latent modeling while preserving fine-grained acoustic details. While existing approaches employ learned compressed representations (e.g., continuous VAE latents) to render prediction tractable, they rely on complex neural encoders that often cap generation fidelity. Conversely, training-free targets like mel-spectrograms eliminate encoder overhead, yet their potential for autoregressive generation remains largely underexplored. In this work, we propose VoxMel, a tokenizer-free framework for autoregressive TTS that makes stable mel modeling tractable through a fixed, exactly invertible two-axis Haar transform. The transform first decomposes each mel spectrogram along frequency into local averages and a frequency residual, then splits the averaged component along time into Coarse-Mel and a temporal residual. A language-model backbone with a flow-matching head autoregressively generates Coarse-Mel. Non-autoregressive residual tiers then predict the temporal residual from Coarse-Mel, followed by the frequency residual conditioned on the reconstructed Frequency-Averaged Mel. Neither residual is fed back into the autoregressive history. Trained on 100K hours of Emilia, the supervised 0.6B model obtains 1.51\% WER and 0.738 speaker similarity (SIM) on test-en, and 1.29\% CER and 0.755 SIM on test-zh. GRPO improves these results to 1.15\% WER / 0.753 SIM and 1.17\% CER / 0.776 SIM, respectively. We also distill the guided flow head into two- and four-step students, requiring 2 or 4 head evaluations per coarse frame. The four-step student retains competitive SIM and nearly matches the supervised model in WER/CER.

ru.title: Точный синтез речи без энкодеров: раскладываем mel-спектрограмму по уровням
ru.desc: Статья представляет VoxMel — tokenizer-free фреймворк для авторегрессионного TTS, который моделирует mel-спектрограммы без обучаемых энкодеров. Используется фиксированное точно обратимое двухосевое преобразование Хаара: сначала по частоте выделяются локальные средние и частотный остаток, затем усреднённая часть делится по времени на Coarse-Mel и временной остаток. LLM-бэкбон с flow-matching головой авторегрессионно генерирует Coarse-Mel, а нерегрессионные residual-уровни восстанавливают детали, при этом остатки не подаются обратно в историю. Модель, обученная на 100K часов Emilia, достигает state-of-the-art по WER, CER и SIM, а дистилляция головы в 2–4 шага сохраняет высокое качество при меньших вычислениях.

en.title: Generate speech from coarse mel, then restore the detail
en.desc: VoxMel is a tokenizer-free text-to-speech system that models mel spectrograms using a fixed, exactly invertible two-axis Haar transform. It splits the spectrogram into a Coarse-Mel tier and temporal and frequency residuals; an autoregressive language model with a flow-matching head generates the Coarse-Mel, while non-autoregressive models predict the residuals. On English and Chinese tests, the system achieves strong word or character error rates and speaker similarity, with further gains from GRPO training. The authors also distill the flow head into faster two- and four-step models, and the four-step version keeps competitive speaker similarity while nearly matching the supervised model’s recognition results.

zh.title: 用可逆频谱分解，让自回归语音生成又稳又细
zh.desc: VoxMel 提出一种无需分词器或学习式声学编码器的自回归文本转语音框架。它用固定且可精确逆变换的双轴 Haar 变换，将梅尔频谱分解为粗粒度梅尔频谱和时间、频率残差。模型通过带流匹配头的语言模型自回归生成粗粒度部分，再以非自回归方式依次预测残差，从而兼顾生成稳定性与声学细节。该方法在中英文语音测试中取得较低的词错误率和字符错误率，并可通过强化学习优化及少步数蒸馏提升效果、加快生成。

papers.title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract  Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task provides a working program and specifies the workload, correctness requirements, timing boundaries, and permitted edits, leaving agents to choose where and how to optimize. Public testing supports iterative development, and a separate verifier scores the final submission. On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness. Their Score@1 ranges from 25.5% to 67.4%. Most of their programs are correct, and the size of the speedup separates them: the two leading agents are at least 2x faster on 22 or more of the 32 tasks, while the other fourteen reach 2x on 8 to 17 and leave 125 of their 412 correct outcomes below 1.25x. Controlled replays show why coordination across an application matters: identical source code runs between 0.29x and 2.12x depending only on build and runtime settings, and one code change is worth 1.01x or 6.4x depending on another. Accelerate Bench pairs executable workloads with agents' programs and trajectories to evaluate both their gains and the process behind them.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

ru.title: Быстрый код важнее правильного кода: оптимизация всей программы, а не отдельных правок
ru.desc: В статье представлен Accelerate Bench — бенчмарк из 32 задач по оптимизации CPU-программ, взятых из научных приложений и суперкомпьютерных соревнований. Агенты на основе LLM должны самостоятельно находить полезные изменения в коде и согласовывать их по всей программе, сохраняя корректность вычислений и укладываясь в ограничения по времени. Оценка проводится на 16 coding agents, и разброс результатов Score@1 составляет от 25.5% до 67.4%, при этом главным отличием является величина ускорения, а не корректность. Эксперименты показывают, что эффект изменений сильно зависит от настроек сборки, рантайма и взаимодействия между правками, поэтому оценивается не только итоговый результат, но и сам процесс оптимизации агентов.

en.title: Benchmarking Coding Agents for End-to-End CPU Speedups
en.desc: The paper introduces Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks based on scientific and supercomputing programs. It evaluates 16 coding agents by checking correctness and measuring speedups, with top agents reaching at least 2× speedup on 22 or more tasks. Results show that optimization depends not only on code changes, but also on coordinating changes across the application and choosing suitable build and runtime settings. The benchmark includes executable workloads and agent trajectories, enabling evaluation of both performance gains and how agents achieve them.

zh.title: 优化不止改代码：让整套程序协同加速
zh.desc: 本文提出 Accelerate Bench，这是一个包含 32 个 CPU 优化任务的基准，任务取材于科学应用和超级计算竞赛。每项任务都提供可运行程序，并规定工作负载、正确性要求、计时范围和允许修改的部分，用于评估编码智能体能否在保持计算正确的同时优化完整程序。对 16 种智能体的测试显示，Score@1 从 25.5% 到 67.4% 不等；领先的两种智能体在至少 22 项任务中实现了 2 倍或更高加速。实验还发现，构建与运行时设置以及不同代码修改之间的配合会显著影响性能，因此该基准也记录程序和智能体的优化过程。

papers.title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Abstract SALA aligns latent actions across human and robot videos by using language-based semantic similarities to form a shared latent action space that supervises embodied foundation model training and improves robot task performance.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision. Compared with world-action models (WAMs), LAMs can offer greater training efficiency and potentially lower inference costs by avoiding explicit pixel prediction during policy learning and execution. However, most existing LAMs learn latent actions solely through video reconstruction, which can cause their representations to cluster by visual appearance rather than by the underlying actions. As a result, they struggle to align human actions with their robot counterparts. To bridge the gap, we introduce SALA, which emphasizes establishing the semantic correspondence for latent actions. Without requiring paired data, we use the language descriptions of unpaired human and robot clips to estimate semantic similarities and supervise cross-embodiment correspondence. Specifically, we translate these similarities into soft neighborhood structures that guide human latent actions toward semantically related robot latents, while robot action reconstruction grounds the latent space in control. The resulting shared latent action space provides a unified supervision signal for training an embodied foundation model on both human and robot videos. Notably, latent action supervision enables scaling along two axes: (1) pre-training on increasing amounts of general human video consistently reduces robot action prediction error on downstream tasks, and (2) post-training on increasing amounts of task-specific human video substantially improves real-world robot task success rates.
affiliations: SJTU-Sharpa Joint Lab for Embodied AI, SJTU

ru.title: Учимся у людей через общий язык действий
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод SALA, который выравнивает латентные действия (latent actions) между видео людей и роботов без парных данных. Семантическое сходство оценивается по языковым описаниям клипов, и на его основе строится мягкая структура соседства, направляющая человеческие латентные действия к семантически близким роботизированным. Реконструкция действий робота закрепляет общее латентное пространство в задачах управления, давая единый сигнал для обучения embodied foundation model. Эксперименты показывают, что предобучение на большом объёме человеческого видео снижает ошибку предсказания действий робота, а дообучение на задаче-специфичных видео заметно повышает успешность выполнения задач в реальном мире.

en.title: Align Actions by Meaning, Learn from More Videos
en.desc: SALA uses language descriptions to find semantic similarities between unpaired human and robot video clips. These similarities guide latent action models to align actions with the same meaning, while robot action reconstruction keeps the representations useful for control. The shared latent action space lets embodied foundation models learn from both human and robot videos without needing paired examples. Experiments show that adding more human video improves robot action prediction and real-world task success.

zh.title: 以语言语义对齐人机潜在动作，拓展机器人学习数据
zh.desc: SALA提出一种让人类视频与机器人视频共享潜在动作表示的方法，以便利用大量人类视频训练具身基础模型。它使用语言描述估计未配对视频片段之间的语义相似度，并将相似度转化为软邻域结构，引导语义相关的人类与机器人潜在动作对齐。与此同时，机器人动作重建使共享潜在空间保留与控制相关的信息。实验表明，增加通用人类视频预训练数据可降低机器人动作预测误差，而增加任务相关的人类视频后训练数据可提高真实机器人任务成功率。

papers.title: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
papers.abstract: Abstract A large language model can output single-chain protein structures from its internal residue states by invoking a pretrained structure head, with reduced long-chain accuracy and MMLU-Pro accuracy in the reported tests.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.

ru.title: LLM учится складывать белки, но жертвует частью своего интеллекта
ru.desc: В статье описывается большая языковая модель (LLM) Qwen3.5-9B, которая получает последовательность белка, обогащенную признаками ESM2, и может выводить 3D-структуру одноцепочечного белка, вызывая предобученную голову SimpleFold. Структурная голова получает информацию о белке только через внутренние состояния остатков LLM, а качество оценивается по TM-score на наборах FoldBench, CASP16 и CAMEO. Сравнение с базовой системой ESM2-3B + SimpleFold-3B показывает близкие результаты для коротких цепей, но заметное отставание для белков длиной 300–600 остатков. Обучение на белковых данных также снижает точность на подвыборке MMLU-Pro с 77.4% до 70.3%, поэтому задачи предсказания комплексов и влияния языкового рассуждения на координаты остаются будущей работой.

en.title: Teaching an LLM to Fold Proteins from Its Own Representations
en.desc: The paper tests whether a large language model (LLM) can use its own residue representations to produce protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads protein sequences with ESM2 features, then passes its residue states to a pretrained SimpleFold structure head to predict coordinates. The system achieves good TM-scores on several single-chain benchmarks, but performs worse than the comparison baseline on longer proteins in the reported tests. Protein training also lowers accuracy on the tested MMLU-Pro questions; predicting protein complexes and using language reasoning to guide structures remain future work.

zh.title: 让语言模型从自身表示出发折叠蛋白质
zh.desc: 这项研究探索让大型语言模型（LLM）利用自身的残基表示来生成单链蛋白质结构。模型以蛋白质序列和 ESM2 残基特征为输入，并可调用一个预训练的 SimpleFold 结构预测头来输出结构。在测试中，该方法能预测蛋白质结构；与基线相比，短链结果差异不明显，但在较长链上的表现较低。蛋白质训练也使模型在所测的 MMLU-Pro 子集上的准确率下降，而复合物预测、结构理解及语言推理对结构的影响仍有待研究。

papers.title: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
papers.abstract: Abstract  Streaming video generation must sustain quality beyond the training horizon while handling self-generated history and growing cache costs. To address these challenges, we present MovieRoll, a base-to-distilled framework that connects streaming fine-tuning, long-rollout distillation, and long-horizon inference. We first establish a robust multi-step base through Window-wise Teacher Forcing (WinTF), which jointly denoises chunks at progressive noise levels with bidirectional attention within each window and causal access to preceding history. To retain historical context efficiently, hierarchical KV-cache compression (HieraKV) exploits layer-wise attention patterns, retaining full history in shallow layers and sink--recent history in deeper layers. This reduces cache memory by up to 78% while improving generation quality. Building on this base, cumulative long tuning with distribution matching distillation (CuLT-DMD) holds parameters fixed throughout each long self-rollout and averages local gradients before updating. Each update therefore combines supervision across temporal positions while retaining only one local computation graph, enabling efficient long-rollout training of a few-step generator. To extend generation beyond the training horizon, KV recomputation bounds context for both models, while guidance annealing (AnnealCFG) reduces guidance toward the clean endpoint to stabilize MovieRoll-Base. Complementing these modeling advances, FBCA attention and PS-VAE decoding support efficient training and streaming output. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll-Base remains competitive at 30s after training on videos of up to 15s, and MovieRoll-Distilled achieves the highest total scores among the compared methods across single- and multi-event evaluations up to 60s, combining sustained naturalness with active motion.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Длинное видео в потоке без потери качества
ru.desc: Статья представляет MovieRoll — фреймворк для потоковой генерации видео, объединяющий потоковое fine-tuning, дистилляцию на длинных self-rollout и инференс на длинном горизонте. Для стабильной базовой модели используется Window-wise Teacher Forcing, а для эффективного хранения истории применяется иерархическое сжатие KV-cache (HieraKV), которое уменьшает память кэша до 78%. Дистилляционный этап CuLT-DMD усредняет локальные градиенты при фиксированных параметрах, позволяя обучать few-step генератор на длинных последовательностях с одним графом вычислений. Эксперименты на HeliosBench показывают, что модели сохраняют качество и динамику видео до 30–60 секунд, обучаясь лишь на роликах до 15 секунд.

en.title: Generate Longer Videos with Less Memory
en.desc: MovieRoll is a framework for generating streaming videos that remain coherent over long durations while keeping memory use manageable. Its base model uses Window-wise Teacher Forcing to learn chunk-by-chunk generation, and HieraKV compresses the key-value cache by keeping different amounts of history in different layers. The distilled model uses CuLT-DMD to train on long self-generated videos efficiently, while KV recomputation and guidance annealing help generation stay stable beyond the training horizon. On HeliosBench, MovieRoll performs competitively at 30 seconds, and its distilled version leads the compared methods across evaluations up to 60 seconds.

zh.title: 压缩历史、蒸馏长程：让流式视频生成走得更远
zh.desc: 本文提出 MovieRoll，一种面向长时流式视频生成的训练与推理框架，目标是在超出训练时长后仍保持视频质量，并控制历史缓存开销。WinTF 通过分窗口的多步去噪训练基础模型；HieraKV 根据不同层的注意力模式压缩键值缓存，最多减少 78% 的内存并提升生成质量。随后，CuLT-DMD 使用长程自回滚蒸馏训练少步生成器，并通过累积多个时间位置的梯度来提高训练效率；KV 重计算和逐渐减弱的引导则帮助模型稳定生成更长视频。在 HeliosBench 上，MovieRoll-Base 在 30 秒生成任务中表现有竞争力，MovieRoll-Distilled 在最长 60 秒的单事件与多事件评测中取得最高总分之一，同时保持自然度和动作活跃度。

papers.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
papers.abstract: Abstract Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, improves compute and data efficiency over standard Transformers, especially when unique data is abundant relative to model size.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train on it for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, is another way to spend that compute, yet it has not been tested against a vanilla Transformer that spends the same compute on more epochs. We run this test across a ladder of model sizes, unique data and epochs, tuning both models at every size and amount of unique data. Latent feedback makes every FLOP and every token count for more except when unique data is scarce relative to model size, a regime that today's models are far from. We find that latent feedback serves as an amplifier: with unique data fixed, it reaches a Transformer's loss with less compute; with epochs fixed, it reaches that loss with less unique data. Furthermore, both savings grow with unique data per parameter and with repetition, and downstream tasks agree. To go beyond our grid, we fit one scaling law to both models, in which latent feedback enters as a Transformer with more parameters; it predicts that both savings keep growing with unique data and repetition. Fitted on models from 60M to 271M parameters, the law predicts the losses at a held-out 778M size to within 0.3% and the gap between the two models to within 0.05%. At most, latent feedback saves 48% of the compute and 47% of the unique data. When data, not compute, is the limit, latent feedback is the better use of a FLOP for a model of a given size.

ru.title: Латентная обратная связь экономит вычисления и данные, когда данных мало
ru.desc: В статье исследуется латентная обратная связь (latent feedback), при которой состояние верхнего слоя каждого токена подаётся на вход следующего токена. Авторы сравнивают её с обычным Transformer, обученным на том же объёме вычислений, но с большим числом эпох на уникальных данных, для разных размеров моделей и объёмов данных. Результаты показывают, что латентная обратная связь выступает усилителем: она достигает того же loss с меньшим числом FLOP или уникальных токенов, а выгода растёт при увеличении данных на параметр и числа повторений. Авторы также предлагают scaling law, которая точно предсказывает поведение модели на 778M параметров по данным моделей от 60M до 271M, и показывают экономию до 48% вычислений и 47% данных.

en.title: Make Every Token and FLOP Go Further
en.desc: The paper compares latent feedback with a standard Transformer using the same compute across different model sizes, data amounts, and training epochs. Latent feedback passes each token’s top-layer hidden state into the next token’s input, improving compute and data efficiency in most tested settings. Its benefits grow when there is more unique training data per model parameter and when data is repeated, with savings reaching 48% of compute and 47% of unique data. A scaling law models latent feedback as a Transformer with more parameters and accurately predicts results at a larger, held-out model size.

zh.title: 让每个 FLOP 与每份数据发挥更大价值
zh.desc: 这篇论文比较了潜在反馈与标准 Transformer：潜在反馈会把每个词元的顶层隐藏状态作为下一个词元的输入。研究者在不同模型规模、独特数据量和训练轮数下进行等计算量实验，发现除独特数据相对模型规模过少时，潜在反馈通常能更有效地利用计算量和数据。它像一种放大器：在达到相同损失时，可以减少计算量或独特数据需求，且数据重复越多、每个参数对应的独特数据越多，节省越明显。论文还拟合了能描述两种模型的缩放定律，并报告潜在反馈最多可节省48%的计算量和47%的独特数据。

papers.title: DominoBench: Evaluating Multi-Step Physical Reasoning from Still Images
papers.abstract: Abstract A new benchmark, DominoBench, shows that current vision-language and multimodal models cannot reliably predict physical outcomes from still images unless the critical calculation and necessary quantities are provided.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Can a vision-language model look at a picture of a chain reaction and tell what will happen? Recent multimodal models describe scenes fluently and solve textbook physics problems, which suggests they should also predict how a scene of ramps, ledges, pendulums, seesaws and dominoes plays out once a ball is pushed. We tested this claim on 30 models from 10 families and reached a clear conclusion: unaided, no model predicts the outcome reliably. We built DominoBench, a benchmark of still images of 2D rigid-body scenes whose outcome a physics simulator computes. It holds 854 items in 427 minimal pairs, in which a change of one to three grid steps in one quantity decides whether one person survives, and every item comes with a four-rung hint ladder ending in the exact calculation that decides the outcome. Unaided, frontier models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI are right about the person whose fate flips in at most 72% of items and answer both twins of a pair correctly in at most 34%. Pointing at the deciding step helps little, and exact geometry given as text barely helps, yet once the deciding calculation and the quantities it needs, including speeds that a still image cannot show, are written out, the same models reach 82-92% on the deciding person, while small open-weight models stay near chance. Physical prediction from a still image therefore fails at the quantitative step: the strongest models use the deciding quantity when they are given it, but do not produce it on their own. For models that plan or act in the physical world, a fluent account of a scene is thus no evidence of a correct prediction: such models must find and compute the deciding quantity unprompted, and DominoBench tests whether they do.

ru.title: Модели красиво описывают домино, но не умеют сами посчитать, что упадёт
ru.desc: Авторы представляют DominoBench — бенчмарк из 854 статичных изображений 2D-сцен с твёрдыми телами, где физический симулятор вычисляет исход цепной реакции. Тестировались 30 моделей, включая vision-language и мультимодальные LLM, и без подсказок ни одна не предсказывала результат надёжно: лучшие модели правильно угадывали судьбу персонажа лишь в 72% случаев. Когда же модели получали явно записанный решающий расчёт и нужные величины (например, скорости, которые не видны на картинке), точность возрастала до 82–92%, тогда как маленькие открытые модели оставались на уровне случайного угадывания. Вывод: модели не могут сами выделить и вычислить ключевую физическую величину, поэтому связное описание сцены не гарантирует верного предсказания для агентов, действующих в физическом мире.

en.title: Seeing the Scene Isn’t Enough: Models Must Compute What Decides
en.desc: DominoBench tests whether vision-language models can predict the outcomes of physical chain reactions from still images. Across 854 scenes, models often fail to identify which person survives, especially when a small change in a paired scene flips the outcome. Giving models the exact calculation and needed quantities, including hidden speeds, greatly improves leading models’ accuracy, suggesting the main weakness is deriving those quantities themselves. The benchmark measures whether models can independently find and compute the decisive information needed for reliable physical prediction.

zh.title: 看懂场景还不够：模型必须算出决定结果的关键物理量
zh.desc: 本文提出 DominoBench 基准，用来检验视觉语言模型能否根据静态图像预测二维刚体场景中的物理结果。基准包含 854 个测试项目，组成 427 对仅有细微差异的场景，并由物理模拟器确定结果。实验发现，模型独立预测时表现不可靠；提供关键计算及所需数值后，先进模型的准确率则明显提高。结果表明，模型的主要困难在于自行找出并计算决定结果的物理量，而不只是理解场景。

papers.title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.abstract: Abstract LoopFill reduces decoding latency for looped language models by combining multi-token suffix drafts and shallow-loop predictions into a single draft tree with full-depth verification that preserves the autoregressive output distribution.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is 5.85times on Ouro-2.6B and 5.13times on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.

ru.title: Больше токенов за один проход: LoopFill ускоряет looped LLM без потери качества
ru.desc: LoopFill — это алгоритм спекулятивного декодирования без дополнительного обучения для looped LLM, то есть моделей, которые многократно применяют одни и те же слои Transformer. Он объединяет multi-token suffix drafts и предсказания с мелких проходов (shallow-loop predictions) в одно общее draft tree, поэтому несколько будущих токенов могут сразу войти в конвейер. Полная верификация на полной глубине сохраняет исходное распределение выходов модели, а значит качество генерации не меняется. На семи бенчмарках ускорение относительно жадного autoregressive декодирования составляет 5.85x для Ouro-2.6B и 5.13x для Huginn-3.5B, что на 40% и 25% выше, чем у сильнейшего базового метода LoopAhead.

en.title: One Draft Tree, Faster Looped Decoding
en.desc: LoopFill speeds up decoding in looped language models, which reuse the same Transformer layers several times for each token. It combines multi-token suffix drafts and predictions from shallow loops into one draft tree, allowing several future tokens to be prepared together. The model verifies these drafts at full depth, preserving the original autoregressive output distribution without additional training. Across seven benchmarks, it achieves higher average speedups than greedy decoding and outperforms the strongest baseline, LoopAhead.

zh.title: 合并草稿树，让循环语言模型解码更快且不改变输出分布
zh.desc: 循环式 Transformer 通过反复使用同一组层来提高参数效率，但逐个生成词元时需要多次串行计算，造成解码延迟。LoopFill 是一种无需训练的推测解码算法，它将多词元后缀草稿与浅循环预测合并到同一棵草稿树中。这样，后缀查找可以立即扩展浅循环预测，并让多个未来词元同时进入流水线；模型再以完整深度验证候选，从而保留自回归输出分布。七项基准测试显示，LoopFill 在 Ouro-2.6B 和 Huginn-3.5B 上分别实现 5.85 倍和 5.13 倍平均加速，优于最强基线 LoopAhead。

papers.title: Ego Guidance: Enhancing Robot Policy Learning with Action-Free Human Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract: Abstract A mixture-of-transformers architecture jointly predicts future visual states and actions, leveraging pretrained vision-language representations and egocentric videos to improve robot policy learning without action supervision.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash In this paper, we investigate how human egocentric videos can benefit robot policy learning without action supervision. Building on a pretrained VLM, we propose Shared Prediction on Action and Representation (SPAR), an MoT architecture in which future visual state prediction can provide independent and complementary learning signals alongside action prediction. We find that representations learned from egocentric videos improve downstream performance on out-of-distribution robot tasks, with further gains as video data scales. We also study the effects of objective choices and data curation, providing insights into how to leverage action-free videos for scalable robot learning.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Учимся у людей по видео без разметки действий
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают архитектуру Shared Prediction on Action and Representation (SPAR) типа Mixture-of-Transformers, построенную на предобученной Vision-Language Model (VLM). Модель совместно обучается предсказывать будущие визуальные состояния и действия робота, при этом предсказание будущих состояний даёт дополнительный независимый и комплементарный сигнал для обучения. Эксперименты показывают, что представления, полученные из эгоцентричных видео людей без разметки действий, улучшают качество policy learning на out-of-distribution задачах робота, причём с ростом объёма видеоданных прирост качества продолжает расти. Также исследуется влияние выбора целевых функций и курирования данных, что дает рекомендации по использованию видео без действий для масштабируемого обучения роботов.

en.title: Teach Robots from Videos, Even Without Action Labels
en.desc: The paper introduces Shared Prediction on Action and Representation (SPAR), a mixture-of-transformers architecture built on a pretrained vision-language model. It learns robot policies using both action prediction and prediction of future visual states, so egocentric videos can help even when they have no action labels. The learned representations improve performance on robot tasks that differ from the training tasks, and performance improves further with more video data. The paper also examines how learning objectives and data curation affect this approach to scalable robot learning.

zh.title: 让无动作标注的视频助力机器人学会行动
zh.desc: 本文研究如何利用人类第一人称视频，在没有动作标注的情况下提升机器人策略学习。作者提出 SPAR，一种基于预训练视觉语言模型的混合 Transformer 架构，同时预测未来视觉状态和动作。未来状态预测提供了独立且互补的学习信号，帮助模型从无动作标注的视频中学习有用表征。实验显示，这些表征能提升机器人在分布外任务上的表现，而且随着视频数据增多，效果进一步改善。

papers.title: Correcting Persistent Failures in Point-Cloud Grasping Policies using Human Demonstrations in Virtual Reality
papers.abstract: Abstract A human-in-the-loop failure-mining pipeline turns persistently unsolved grasps of a reinforcement-learning point-cloud policy into virtual-reality human demonstrations, improving hard-case success without reducing generalization to unseen objects.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Robots in homes, warehouses and farms must pick up objects they have never seen, usually without a 3D model or a category label. A grasping policy that works directly on the point cloud from a depth sensor needs only the geometry the robot observes, so it applies to any new object. Offline grasp generators such as Contact-GraspNet work this way, but they rank grasps by learned plausibility rather than by whether the grasp actually lifts the object. Reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize for that directly and make a point-cloud grasping policy much better on average, yet it leaves specific grasps persistently unsolved. We present a human-in-the-loop failure loop that targets those grasps: situations an RL policy keeps failing are mined automatically, sent to a virtual-reality application where a person picks the object up with their own hands, and returned to training as two grasp points. The person contributes only where to grasp; the robot chooses its own approach. In simulation, RL raises success on unseen objects from 55% with Contact-GraspNet to 83%. Adding 58 human demonstrations nearly doubles success on the hard cases RL kept failing, from 24% to 45%, and recovers performance that RL alone loses on similar cases that were never demonstrated, without reducing success on unseen objects.

ru.title: Человек показывает, где хватать, а робот сам решает, как
ru.desc: Статья описывает конвейер обучения захвата объектов роботом, где политика обучается с подкреплением (RL) напрямую на облаке точек от глубинного сенсора, без 3D-модели и без метки категории. Систематически находятся захваты, которые RL-политика постоянно не может выполнить, и отправляются в VR-приложение, где человек указывает две точки захвата своими руками. Эти демонстрации возвращаются в обучение, а сам подход к захвату выбирает робот. В симуляции RL поднимает успешность на невиданных объектах с 55% (Contact-GraspNet) до 83%, а добавление 58 человеческих демонстраций почти удваивает успех на сложных случаях — с 24% до 45%, не ухудшая обобщение.

en.title: Turn Repeated Grasp Failures into Human-Guided Learning
en.desc: This paper presents a human-in-the-loop method for improving a reinforcement-learning (RL) robot grasping policy that uses depth-camera point clouds. The system finds grasps the policy repeatedly fails, then asks a person in virtual reality to provide two grasp points; the robot still plans its own approach. In simulation, RL improves success on unseen objects from 55% to 83% compared with Contact-GraspNet, while 58 human demonstrations raise success on hard cases from 24% to 45%. The demonstrations also help with similar cases that were not shown to people, without lowering performance on unseen objects.

zh.title: 让人示范失败难例，让机器人学会更可靠地抓取
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出一种人在环的失败挖掘流程，用来改进基于点云的强化学习抓取策略。系统会自动找出策略反复失败的抓取情形，再让人通过虚拟现实示范应当抓取物体的两个位置；机器人仍自行决定如何接近物体。仿真结果显示，强化学习将未见物体上的抓取成功率从 Contact-GraspNet 的 55% 提高到 83%；加入 58 个人类示范后，难例成功率从 24% 提高到 45%。这些示范还能帮助策略应对相似但未示范的难例，同时不降低对未见物体的泛化能力。

papers.title: UMM-JEPA: Generative Pretraining via Masked Next-Scale Representation Prediction for Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Reformulating generation as progressive prediction of continuous perceptual representations improves visual understanding in unified multimodal models more than discrete-code or latent-flow objectives.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Unified multimodal models can support both visual understanding and generation, yet generative training does not necessarily improve understanding. We argue that this limitation may arise from a mismatch between the representation targeted by generation and the perceptual representation used for understanding. Conventional generation objectives primarily optimize synthesis-oriented spaces such as discrete visual codes or generative latents. We therefore introduce UMM-JEPA, which reformulates generation as progressive prediction of continuous visual-understanding representations. The model constructs a multi-scale representation hierarchy from coarse to fine, while pixel rendering is decoupled from representation pretraining and attached only afterward. Controlled comparisons show that the representation-prediction objective accounts for most of the understanding improvement, while a data-matched control leaves the group means nearly unchanged. UMM-JEPA reaches a 16-benchmark visual mean of 51.71, against 46.36 for the understanding-only Qwen-VL baseline, and the text mean also rises. Compared with discrete-code and latent-flow generation objectives, perceptual representation prediction yields stronger and more consistent transfer to understanding. Linear probes and visual-evidence interventions further reveal richer object and spatial structure and stronger use of image-specific information. These results suggest that generation can benefit understanding when it directly supervises the perceptual representations that understanding consumes.

ru.title: Генерация, которая учит понимать: предсказываем то, что модель реально видит
ru.desc: В статье предлагается UMM-JEPA — подход, в котором генерация изображений в унифицированных мультимодальных моделях (unified multimodal models) сводится к прогрессивному предсказанию непрерывных перцептивных представлений, используемых для понимания. Модель строит иерархию представлений от грубых к детальным, а рендеринг пикселей отделён от предобучения представлений и подключается лишь на последнем этапе. Контролируемые эксперименты показывают, что основной прирост качества понимания даёт именно цель предсказания представлений, а не просто объём данных, и средний результат на 16 бенчмарках вырос до 51.71 против 46.36 у базовой Qwen-VL. Линейные пробы и интервенции с визуальными свидетельствами подтверждают, что модель лучше учитывает структуру объектов и пространственные отношения.

en.title: Train generation to predict what understanding needs
en.desc: The paper introduces UMM-JEPA, a unified multimodal model that learns generation by progressively predicting continuous visual representations. Unlike methods that predict discrete visual codes or generative latents, it trains the model to predict perceptual representations used for visual understanding. Tests show that this objective improves visual understanding across 16 benchmarks, and also raises the text benchmark mean, compared with an understanding-only baseline. Probes and interventions indicate that the model learns richer object and spatial structure and uses image-specific evidence more effectively.

zh.title: 让生成直接学习理解所需的视觉表征
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出 UMM-JEPA，将图像生成改为逐步预测连续的视觉理解表征，而不是预测离散视觉编码或生成潜变量。模型按由粗到细的多尺度层级学习这些表征，并把像素渲染与表征预训练分开。实验显示，这种表征预测目标带来的视觉理解提升明显优于其他生成目标，且数据匹配的对照实验几乎没有提升。线性探测和视觉证据干预也表明，模型学到了更丰富的物体与空间结构，并更能利用图像本身的信息。

papers.title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
papers.abstract: Abstract  Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

ru.title: Управляй миром жестами: генерация видео с точным контролем рук в реальном времени
ru.desc: Статья представляет LynnReal-Hand — видео-модель мира, которой можно управлять движениями рук, что позволяет напрямую взаимодействовать с объектами в генерируемой сцене. Авторы собрали датасет из 100 тысяч клипов с взаимодействиями и ввели hand-aware supervision для точного моделирования мелкой моторики и динамики «рука-объект». Для быстрой генерации используется causal flow map с небольшим числом шагов и region-aware score distillation, а декодер Ultra-Fast-VAE снижает задержку при сохранении качества. На HandBench модель превосходит аналоги по точности следования за рукой и визуальному качеству и работает в реальном времени на одном H200 со стримингом 540p.

en.title: Hands-on Control for Fast, Real-Time Video Worlds
en.desc: LynnReal-Hand is a video world model that lets users control scenes by moving their hands. The researchers collect 100,000 interaction clips and use hand-aware supervision to improve how the model represents hand motion and object interactions. They combine a causal flow map for efficient few-step video generation with region-aware score distillation, and build a compact video decoder to reduce inference costs. On HandBench, the model achieves strong hand-following accuracy and visual quality, while its streaming version runs at 18.03 FPS with 741 ms latency on a single H200 GPU.

zh.title: 让手势成为实时视频世界的精准交互方式
zh.desc: 本文提出 LynnReal-Hand，一种通过手部动作控制视频世界模型的系统，让用户能更精细地与视频中的物体互动。研究团队整理了涵盖真实与合成环境的十万段互动视频，并设计手部感知监督，以提升手部动作和物体交互的建模精度。模型利用因果流映射实现少步生成，并通过区域感知的分数蒸馏融合视频与图像先验；此外，Ultra-Fast-VAE 解码器降低了计算成本和延迟。实验显示，该方法在手部跟随准确度与视觉质量方面表现突出，也能以较低延迟进行实时视频生成。

papers.title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
papers.abstract: Abstract OutfitterBench evaluates LLM agents managing a 200-day outdoor-equipment rental business under fixed capital and uncertain demand, revealing limitations in sustaining feasible commitments and reallocating resources.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash In many long-horizon settings, an agent's own choices create future constraints: committing finite capacity establishes future obligations and forecloses later opportunities. Sustaining performance therefore requires both keeping evolving plans feasible and comparing the value of resource allocations with the alternatives they displace. Recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate LLM agents in continuing operations, but give less attention to how agents keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocations as opportunities change. We introduce OutfitterBench, where agents manage an outdoor-equipment rental business for 200 days, purchasing from a 46-product catalog and handling roughly 1,100 reservation requests. Under a fixed capital ceiling, reservations and uncertain walk-in demand compete for reusable equipment whose availability changes over time. Experiments with seven frontier LLMs show that several agents underperform a simple rule-based baseline, while only the leading agent consistently surpasses it. Trajectory analysis shows that some agents apply known constraints inconsistently and make new decisions that conflict with existing commitments. Agents with more reliable fulfillment can still secure low returns from comparable commitments or delay resource reallocation. The leading agent better connects preparation with economic choices but also misses opportunities for more profitable asset use. These findings highlight limitations in sustaining coherent resource plans and reassessing their value over time. The benchmark code is publicly available at https://github.com/adminblackjack/OutfitterBench.
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Агенты LLM теряют связность планов, когда ресурсы ограничены и обязательства накапливаются
ru.desc: Авторы представляют OutfitterBench, бенчмарк, в котором LLM-агенты 200 дней управляют бизнесом по аренде туристического снаряжения при фиксированном капитале и неопределённом спросе. Агентам нужно выполнять бронирования и одновременно распределять переиспользуемое оборудование между резервациями и заказами «с улицы». Эксперименты с семью frontier LLM показали, что многие агенты уступают простой rule-based baseline, и лишь лучший агент стабильно её превосходит. Анализ траекторий выявил непоследовательное соблюдение ограничений и решения, противоречащие уже принятым обязательствам, а также запаздывание с перераспределением ресурсов.

en.title: Keep Commitments, Reallocate for What Pays
en.desc: OutfitterBench tests how well language-model agents run an equipment rental business for 200 days, with limited money, uncertain demand, and reusable gear. The agents must honor existing reservations while deciding how to spend money and allocate equipment to new opportunities. Most tested models perform worse than a simple rule-based system, and only the strongest consistently does better. Even strong agents struggle to keep plans consistent and shift resources toward more profitable uses over time.

zh.title: 守住承诺，更要让资源持续创造价值
zh.desc: 本文提出 OutfitterBench，用来评估大语言模型智能体经营户外装备租赁业务的能力。智能体需要在固定资金和不确定需求下，管理采购、预订与可重复使用的库存，并连续运营 200 天。实验发现，许多模型不如简单的规则基线，常会违反已有承诺，或未能及时把资源转投更有价值的用途。结果显示，长期经营不仅要求维持计划可行，还需要持续比较资源配置的收益与其他选择。

papers.title: Continuation-Guided LLM Evolution of Program Policies and Goal Compilers in Craftax
papers.abstract: Abstract A framework uses coding agents and a feedback cascade to synthesize code-based policies that achieve long-horizon success and can be factored into a reusable goal compiler for zero-shot transfer to new tasks.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Coding agents can synthesize and optimize code-based policies from simulator feedback, allowing the resulting program to act with zero inference model calls. But for long horizon tasks, two challenges arise: local improvements can hurt final success and switching to a new objective requires another expensive synthesis run. We propose a framework that first develops competence by refining the policy through a feedback cascade, moving from episode returns to hierarchical goals and belief updates which can be scored densely from simulator. In the Craftax game, a partially observed and procedurally generated environment, refinements via episode level feedback stall at <1% final-level arrival, whereas with the feedback cascade the optimized policy reaches the final stage 50% of time (28% final boss defeats). Furthermore, to make this competence reusable towards new goals, we factor the previous controller into an environment interpreter I (models, memory, skills) and a rule program p_0, and we show that coding agents can optimize a reusable goal compiler C_θ that maps structured tasks g into new rule programs p_g. Across five independent compiler searches trained only on short tasks, the resulting compilers successfully transfer zero-shot to longer tasks without any task-specific tuning nor inference-time LLM calls: continuation-scored feedback and a fixed machine with an editable program together turn a single-task competent policy into a reusable one.   Code at: https://github.com/vicgalle/craftax-program-policies

ru.title: От одноразового решения к переиспользуемому компилятору целей
ru.desc: Статья описывает фреймворк, в котором coding agents (агенты-программисты) синтезируют и улучшают кодовые политики на основе обратной связи от симулятора, так что итоговая программа работает без вызовов LLM. Для длинных горизонтов предложен каскад обратной связи: от наград эпизода к иерархическим целям и обновлению belief, что позволяет плотно оценивать прогресс и резко повышает долю успешного достижения финального уровня в среде Craftax. Далее среда разбивается на интерпретатор окружения и базовую rule-программу, а coding agents оптимизируют переиспользуемый goal compiler, который переводит структурированные задачи в новые программы правил. Компиляторы, обученные только на коротких задачах, без дообучения и без вызовов LLM переносятся на более длинные задачи в режиме zero-shot.

en.title: Build One Strong Policy, Then Compile It for New Goals
en.desc: The paper presents a framework where coding agents use simulator feedback to build and improve programs that control an environment, without needing language-model calls during execution. A feedback cascade scores progress at several levels, from whole-episode outcomes to smaller goals and belief updates, helping improvements support long-term success. In the Craftax game, this approach reaches the final stage in 50% of attempts and defeats the final boss in 28%, compared with under 1% final-stage arrival using episode-level feedback alone. The authors also introduce a reusable goal compiler that turns new task descriptions into programs, enabling zero-shot transfer to longer tasks without task-specific tuning.

zh.title: 用反馈级联学会长程任务，让目标编译器实现零样本迁移
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出一种利用编码智能体和模拟器反馈，自动生成并优化代码策略的方法；策略运行时无需调用推理模型。为解决长时程任务中局部改进未必提升最终成功率的问题，框架采用逐级反馈级联：先依据整局回报优化，再利用层级目标和信念状态更新提供更密集的反馈。在 Craftax 游戏中，这种方法将到达最终阶段的成功率提升至 50%，击败最终首领的比例达到 28%，而只用整局反馈时到达率低于 1%。研究还把控制器拆分为环境解释器和规则程序，并训练可复用的目标编译器，将新任务转换成规则程序，使策略能够零样本迁移到更长任务，无需针对新任务微调或在执行时调用大语言模型。

papers.title: Centered Ablation: Why Last-Layer Directional Ablation Under-Fires or Collapses, and a Closed-Form Fix
