papers.abstract: Abstract  Directional ablation removes a hidden state's component along a "behaviour direction" while a language model runs. It is the standard way to switch a behaviour such as refusal off, but it is erratic: on some models it barely fires, on others the text collapses into repetition. We show why, and fix it. At the last residual stream, ablation is exactly a logit bias: a fixed vocabulary footprint scaled by a gate, the cosine between the hidden state and the direction. The gate is measured from the origin, but last-layer states share a large common mode far from it, so a direction that overlaps the common mode fires on benign text and under-fires on its targets. Centered Ablation (CA) projects the common mode out of the direction, in closed form. Across 8 models, CA raises attack success by 29 and 46 points where the standard recipe under-fires, cuts collapse on Gemma-2-9B from 50\% to 1\%, and preserves 12 to 40 points more benign answers on high-overlap models, 39 to 46 more than the affine offset of prior work. Two numbers computed before generation predict, on models the analysis had not seen, which gain faithfulness and which gain attack success, and a collapse index marks when text degenerates. We also show that two standard safety judges score collapsed text in opposite directions, which can fabricate a 46-point effect.

ru.title: Центрируй направление — и абляция перестанет сбоить
ru.desc: Статья рассматривает directional ablation — метод отключения поведения LLM (например, отказов) путём удаления компоненты скрытого состояния вдоль «поведенческого направления». Авторы показывают, что на последнем слое эта операция эквивалентна logit bias, а её нестабильность связана с общей модой (common mode) скрытых состояний, из-за которой направление захватывает нерелевантный текст. Предложенный метод Centered Ablation (CA) в замкнутом виде проецирует общую моду из направления, что повышает успешность атак и снижает деградацию текста на 8 моделях. Также вводятся предварительные метрики и индекс коллапса, а показано, что две стандартные оценки безопасности по-разному оценивают вырожденный текст.

en.title: Center the direction; make ablation behave
en.desc: Directional ablation removes part of a language model’s hidden state to alter a behavior, but it can be unreliable and cause repetitive, collapsed text. The paper explains that at the final residual stream, this method acts like a logit bias whose strength depends on how much the hidden state aligns with the ablation direction. Because hidden states share a large common component, the alignment can be misleading; Centered Ablation (CA) removes that component from the direction in closed form. Across eight models, CA improves attack success and preserves more benign answers while greatly reducing text collapse, and the paper also shows that safety judges can score collapsed outputs inconsistently.

zh.title: 去除共同偏移，让方向消融更精准
zh.desc: 方向消融会在语言模型生成时，移除隐藏状态沿某个“行为方向”的分量，常用于关闭拒绝等行为，但效果可能不稳定。论文指出，在最后一层残差流中，消融等价于给词表 logits 加上一个固定偏置，其强度由隐藏状态与行为方向的余弦相似度门控；由于隐藏状态带有远离原点的共同成分，原方法可能误伤无害文本，也可能无法有效作用于目标文本。作者提出中心化消融（CA），通过闭式投影从行为方向中去除共同成分；在8个模型上的实验显示，它能提升攻击成功率、减少生成崩溃，并在某些模型上更好地保留无害回答。论文还发现，生成前计算的两个指标可以预测不同模型的收益类型，且文本崩溃会让两种常用安全评估器给出相反判断，从而虚构出很大的效果差异。

papers.title: GlyphAtlas: Disentangling Stroke Detail from Layout for Scene Text Synthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract GlyphAtlas uses a dedicated glyph atlas and atlas-anchored attention to provide fine-grained stroke references for scene text synthesis, improving stroke accuracy and zero-shot transfer.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash Scene text synthesis requires stroke-accurate characters rendered in a specified layout, as well as visual coherence with the surrounding scene. To achieve this, existing methods commonly pre-render the target text at its intended locations to form a glyph image that jointly specifies layout and glyph structure. However, this representation ties the resolution of each glyph to its target region, limiting fine-grained stroke guidance for small, densely packed, or structurally complex text. To tackle this, we propose GlyphAtlas, a scene text synthesis framework that retains the glyph image as a spatial anchor and supplies fine-grained stroke references through a dedicated glyph atlas. The atlas renders and encodes each character or word in a separate cell, decoupling reference resolution from target-region size. We further introduce atlas-anchored attention, which lets each text region retrieve stroke detail only from its corresponding atlas cells to refine the coarse glyph structure provided by the glyph image. This coarse-to-fine conditioning simplifies stroke rendering while preserving explicit layout correspondence. We optimize GlyphAtlas with a mask-weighted flow matching objective and a timestep-weighted text perceptual loss for writing accuracy and background consistency. Random resolution augmentation of atlas cells supports adjustable atlas budgets at inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GlyphAtlas achieves stroke-accurate synthesis of small, dense, and structurally complex text, zero-shot transfer to languages unseen during task-specific training, and leading performance in scenes with many text regions. project page: https://fr0zencrane.github.io/project-glyphatlas/

ru.title: Точные штрихи в каждой букве: от грубого глифа к детальному атласу
ru.desc: В статье представлен GlyphAtlas — фреймворк для синтеза текста в сцене (scene text synthesis), который сохраняет глиф-изображение как пространственный якорь и добавляет отдельный glyph atlas с мелкими деталями штрихов для каждого символа или слова. Механизм atlas-anchored attention позволяет каждой текстовой области извлекать детали только из соответствующих ячеек атласа, уточняя грубую структуру глифа по схеме coarse-to-fine. Модель обучается с помощью mask-weighted flow matching и timestep-weighted text perceptual loss, а случайная аугментация разрешения ячеек позволяет регулировать бюджет атласа на этапе инференса. Эксперименты показывают высокую точность штрихов для мелкого и плотного текста, zero-shot перенос на языки, не виденные при обучении, и лучшие результаты в сценах с большим количеством текстовых областей.

en.title: A dedicated glyph atlas brings fine strokes to every scene
en.desc: GlyphAtlas improves scene text synthesis by separating text layout from detailed stroke references. It keeps a glyph image as a spatial anchor and places each character or word in a high-resolution cell of a dedicated glyph atlas, so small text regions can still receive fine stroke detail. Atlas-anchored attention connects each text region to its matching atlas cells, refining the glyph image’s coarse structure while preserving layout. With flow matching, a text perceptual loss, and resolution augmentation, the method produces accurate text and transfers to languages unseen during task-specific training.

zh.title: 以字形图集精细引导笔画，让场景文字清晰准确
zh.desc: GlyphAtlas 是一种用于场景文字合成的框架，目标是在指定布局和背景中生成笔画准确的文字。它保留文字图像作为空间锚点，并用独立字形图集提供高分辨率笔画参考，从而避免字形细节受目标区域大小限制。其图集锚定注意力让每个文字区域只从对应的图集单元检索细节，再以由粗到细的方式完善字形结构。实验表明，该方法能更好地生成小型、密集和结构复杂的文字，并可迁移到训练中未见过的语言。

papers.title: Zuse: A Decision Model for European Languages
papers.abstract: Abstract  Decision models read a document and return a probability for each of a fixed set of options instead of generating text. Several appeared in 2026, but none has published results outside English. We describe Zuse, three decision models (4B, 9B and 27B) that train a low-rank adapter and a pointer head on frozen open-weight bases, targeting 27 European languages, and use them to study how this design behaves across languages and tasks. On a broad European suite of 11 sources excluded from training, covering 9 task groups and 27 languages, a development set that also guided model selection, the 27B model reaches 87.5% accuracy with a pooled expected calibration error of 0.016, and 0.035 when weighted per source. Post-hoc analyses of these single-seed results give three findings. First, miscalibration is structured by task rather than language: on parallel reading and topic items in 26 languages the confidence gap varies about as much as sampling noise, while across sources it spans -0.07 to +0.09, with knowledge tasks overconfident and acceptability judgements underconfident at all three sizes, so one fitted temperature cannot correct both. Second, the share of decisions that can be automated at a 5% error budget follows chance-corrected skill (Spearman 0.97 over 33 source and model pairs) more closely than raw accuracy (0.91). Third, reach beyond the training languages is set by the base model: across 210 languages, changing the training run moved scores by at most about 2 points within a size, while languages outside the base's documented list trail by 23 to 28 points at every size. On English public suites Zuse is behind Jev and Kev, including Kev models on the same bases. We also report two pitfalls in building multi-source training data: label-word collision between topic schemes, and an injection augmentation that taught a shortcut. Zuse can be tried at https://bineric.com/zuse.

ru.title: Zuse: Многоязычные decision-модели, которые знают, насколько они уверены
ru.desc: Статья представляет Zuse — три decision-модели (4B, 9B и 27B), которые читают документ и возвращают вероятности для фиксированного набора вариантов, а не генерируют текст. Модели обучены как LoRA-адаптеры и pointer head поверх замороженных open-weight baseline LLM и ориентированы на 27 европейских языков. На европейском наборе из 11 источников, не входивших в обучение, лучшая модель 27B достигает точности 87.5% и низкой калибровочной ошибки (ECE 0.016). Анализ показывает, что miscalibration определяется типом задачи, а не языком, а охват языков зависит от базовой модели.

en.title: One Decision Model, Many Languages—But Task and Base-Model Limits Matter
en.desc: Zuse is a set of 4B, 9B, and 27B decision models that use low-rank adapters and pointer heads on frozen open-weight models to classify documents across 27 European languages. On a broad, held-out European evaluation suite, the largest model achieved 87.5% accuracy and low pooled calibration error, though its results were based on a single training run and a development set used for model selection. The analysis found that confidence errors vary more by task than by language, that safe automation rates track chance-corrected skill, and that performance in languages beyond a base model’s documented coverage is substantially lower. Zuse trails some competing models on English benchmarks, and the paper also describes data-building pitfalls involving conflicting labels and shortcut learning.

zh.title: 多语言决策模型：任务决定校准，基础模型决定语言覆盖
zh.desc: Zuse 是一组用于分类决策的模型，针对 27 种欧洲语言训练低秩适配器和指针头，同时保持开放权重基础模型冻结。它在未参与训练的多语言测试集上表现良好，但校准误差会因任务类型而异：知识任务容易过度自信，判断可接受性的任务则容易信心不足，因此单一温度缩放难以同时校正两者。可自动化处理的决策比例与校正随机水平后的技能相关性，比与原始准确率的相关性更强；模型对训练数据以外语言的能力，则主要受基础模型覆盖范围限制。研究还指出，多来源训练数据可能出现标签词冲突或模型学会数据增强捷径；在英语公开基准上，Zuse 的表现仍落后于 Jev 和 Kev。

papers.title: Dataset Distillation via Drifting
papers.abstract: Abstract A dataset distillation method learns synthetic samples that approximate per-class data distributions in a feature extractor's latent space, improving distribution coverage and classification training while supporting visualization and other modalities.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash The task of dataset distillation concerns the learning of a small set of synthetic samples that can serve as an effective replacement for a large real dataset when used for downstream tasks. While many solutions have been proposed since the problem's inception, most of them primarily seek to optimize the distilled data with respect to a classifier. In this work, we propose a new distillation method that learns a set of samples such that they directly approximate the per-class data distribution. Specifically, we "drift" our distilled data in the latent space of a feature extractor such that they move both toward the real data and away from each other without using a classification objective. We find that our drifted data cover the real distribution significantly better than existing methods while still serving as powerful training samples for classification. Furthermore, we showcase our method's use as a visualization tool for better interpreting models and extend it beyond images to other modalities. Our work advances the frontier of dataset distillation, offering a novel synthesis method and proposing distribution-based metrics as a complementary evaluation. More broadly, our findings help address the growing need to understand both data and models by uncovering more about how they interact.

ru.title: Синтетические данные, которые повторяют распределение реального мира
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают новый метод дистилляции датасета, который обучает небольшой набор синтетических образцов аппроксимировать распределение данных каждого класса. Образцы «дрейфуют» в латентном пространстве экстрактора признаков: они приближаются к реальным данным и отталкиваются друг от друга, без использования классификационной функции потерь. Такие данные лучше покрывают реальное распределение, чем у существующих методов, и при этом остаются эффективными для обучения классификаторов. Метод также применим как инструмент визуализации для интерпретации моделей и расширен на модальности помимо изображений.

en.title: Distill data by matching distributions, not classifier outputs
en.desc: This paper introduces a dataset distillation method that creates a small set of synthetic samples to represent each class’s data distribution. It moves the samples through a feature extractor’s latent space, pulling them toward real data while pushing them apart from one another, without optimizing a classifier’s predictions. The resulting samples cover the real data distribution better than prior methods and remain useful for training classifiers. The method can also help visualize and interpret models, and it extends to data beyond images.

zh.title: 在潜在空间中贴近真实分布，让少量合成数据发挥更大作用
zh.desc: 本文提出一种数据集蒸馏方法，生成少量合成样本来替代大量真实训练数据。它在特征提取器的潜在空间中调整样本，使样本靠近真实数据分布，同时彼此远离，而不依赖分类目标进行优化。实验显示，这种方法能更充分地覆盖真实数据分布，并且仍能有效训练分类器。该方法还可用于模型可视化，并扩展到图像以外的其他模态。

papers.title: A Reinforcement Learning Method to Navigate SMEFT Operator Space
papers.abstract: Abstract A reinforcement learning agent with a lightweight actor-critic architecture explores the Standard Model Effective Field Theory operator space to discover diverse high-quality theory hypotheses and improve global fits.  Generated by deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash In particle physics, discrepancies between experimental measurements and Standard Model (SM) predictions are commonly interpreted within new theoretical models. In this context, the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) provides a general framework encompassing a broad class of models. However, exploring the enormous space of possible SMEFT operators rapidly becomes a challenging combinatorial problem: many operators can contribute simultaneously to different observables, their effects are correlated, and distinct operator combinations can provide comparably good descriptions of the data. In this work, we formulate the exploration of the SMEFT operator space as a sequential decision-making problem using reinforcement learning (RL). Our RL agent employs a lightweight actor-critic architecture with approximately 40K trainable parameters in total. Rather than searching for a single best-fit theory, our method is designed to discover a diverse set of high-quality theory hypotheses. We test the method in a complex phenomenological environment comprising 132 observables across several sectors of particle physics, including 24 measurements that deviate from their SM predictions by more than 1.5σ. We show that the learned RL policy efficiently constructs multi-operator theories that substantially improve the global fit. Comparisons with independent random-subset and random-sequential searches demonstrate the ability of the RL policy to navigate this large combinatorial space. Our results establish RL as a systematic framework for exploring diverse patterns of new physics (NP) interactions within SMEFT.

ru.title: RL-агент исследует пространство новой физики и находит разнообразные теории, объясняющие данные
ru.desc: В статье предложен подход, в котором reinforcement learning агент с компактной actor-critic архитектурой (около 40K обучаемых параметров) исследует пространство операторов Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT), чтобы объяснить расхождения между экспериментом и предсказаниями Standard Model. Задача формулируется как последовательное принятие решений, а не поиск одной best-fit теории, и агент находит разнообразный набор качественных многооператорных гипотез. Метод тестируется на среде из 132 наблюдаемых, включая 24 измерения с отклонением более 1.5σ, и заметно улучшает global fit. Сравнение с random-subset и random-sequential поисками показывает, что RL-политика эффективно ориентируется в комбинаторно огромном пространстве.

en.title: Reinforcement Learning Navigates SMEFT’s Vast Theory Space
en.desc: The paper treats the search for Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) operators as a sequential decision-making task. A lightweight reinforcement learning agent, using an actor-critic architecture, builds theories by selecting combinations of operators. Tested on 132 particle-physics observables, its learned policy finds diverse theories that improve the global fit and compares favorably with random search methods. The approach offers a systematic way to explore possible patterns of new-physics interactions.

zh.title: 用强化学习探索新物理理论的广阔空间
zh.desc: 这项研究把标准模型有效场论（SMEFT）中寻找算符组合的问题建模为序贯决策任务，并用强化学习进行探索。智能体采用轻量级的演员-评论家架构，总计约有4万个可训练参数，目标是找到多种高质量理论假设，而非只寻找单一最佳拟合。研究在涵盖粒子物理多个领域的132项观测量上测试该方法，结果显示它能高效构建包含多个算符的理论，并显著改善全局拟合。与随机搜索方法相比，强化学习策略能更有效地探索庞大的组合空间，为系统发现SMEFT中的多样新物理相互作用模式提供了方法。

papers.title: Reflection Anchors for Propagation-Aware Visual Retention in Long-Chain Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Long chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves large vision--language models, but visual information often fades during generation, limiting long-horizon multimodal reasoning. Existing methods either re-inject vision at inference or train policies for stronger grounding, but where to intervene relies on perception heuristics rather than principled gain analysis, and how local visual influence propagates remains implicit. We study this problem from an information-theoretic standpoint and derive a lower bound on the downstream visual gain of a one-step intervention, which suggests two factors: local branching room (token entropy) and downstream visual propagation potential (suffix divergence from a vision-marginalized reference). Guided by this analysis, we propose reflection-anchor policy optimization (RAPO), a GRPO-based policy optimization method that selects high-entropy reflection anchors and optimizes a chain-masked finite-window KL surrogate for downstream visual dependence. Experiments on reasoning-intensive and general-domain benchmarks show that RAPO delivers substantial gains over strong baselines across multiple LVLM backbones. Mechanism analyses further indicate that reflection anchors are enriched for visually sensitive decision points and that RAPO increases contrastive visual-dependence signals along generated trajectories.

ru.title: Возвращаем взгляд модели к картинке в длинных рассуждениях
ru.desc: Статья посвящена проблеме затухания визуальной информации в длинных цепочках рассуждений (chain-of-thought) больших vision-language моделей (LVLM). Авторы выводят с помощью теории информации нижнюю оценку визуального выигрыша от одношагового вмешательства, зависящую от энтропии токенов и дивергенции суффикса относительно визуально-маргинализированной ссылки. На основе этого анализа предлагается метод RAPO: GRPO-подобная оптимизация политики, которая выбирает высокоэнтропийные «reflection anchors» и использует маскированный суррогат KL на конечном окне. Эксперименты показывают заметный прирост качества над сильными baseline-моделями на разных LVLM-бэкбонах.

en.title: Keep Vision in the Reasoning Chain
en.desc: Long chain-of-thought reasoning can help large vision-language models, but visual details may fade as they generate long answers. This paper derives an information-theoretic lower bound showing that useful intervention points depend on token entropy and how strongly later text depends on visual input. It proposes reflection-anchor policy optimization (RAPO), a GRPO-based method that selects high-entropy points and trains the model to preserve visual influence over a finite window of later tokens. Experiments show that RAPO improves performance across benchmarks and increases visual dependence along generated reasoning trajectories.

zh.title: 抓住高熵反思锚点，让视觉信息贯穿长链推理
zh.desc: 长链式思维推理能提升大型视觉语言模型的表现，但生成过程中的视觉信息容易逐渐减弱，影响多步多模态推理。本文从信息论角度分析何时重新引入视觉信息更有效，并指出关键因素包括局部 token 熵，以及后续文本对视觉信息的依赖程度。基于此，作者提出反思锚点策略优化（RAPO），一种基于 GRPO 的方法：选取高熵位置作为反思锚点，并通过链式掩码的有限窗口 KL 目标强化后续推理对视觉信息的依赖。实验显示，RAPO 在多种视觉语言模型和不同基准上优于强基线；分析也发现，它能找出对视觉信息敏感的决策点，并增强生成过程中的视觉依赖信号。
